strengthening_paths.suggestion: Redefine the oracle signature to retain every regime-MAG unshielded collider involving zeta as well as observed-only colliders, then restate the compatibility fiber and canonical SI-PAG against Dai et al.'s full regime-MAG equivalence criterion.

Audit the selected-subgraph replacement against Dai et al.'s Lemma 5: indicator adjacency may arise from a direct target or an indirectly affected ancestrally selected variable, so replace the step setting T_k=Z_k with a construction that distinguishes those cases or make that distinction an explicit witness obligation.

Give a worked three- or four-observed-node twin-graph instance showing that the repaired signature, selectedness certificates, and proposed rule handle recover a nontrivial endpoint without enumerating compatible basal DAGs.
Obtain and cite the exact ICML 2026 proceedings/OpenReview theorem text for Zhou and Kocaoglu before retaining any proof-level contrast with its enumeration procedure.
